project_name: Lauofgirly - Link in Bio Beauty Experience
archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY / LUXURY BEAUTY (Pastel & Soft French Aesthetics)

colors.rules: Hot pink (#FF4D8D) is reserved EXCLUSIVELY for the main CTA button ('Viens voir') and its repeating instance. No other element on the page may use #FF4D8D. Pure black (#000000) is strictly forbidden.

hierarchy.name_hero: font-script text-5xl sm:text-6xl tracking-wide leading-tight drop-shadow-sm
hierarchy.tagline: font-sans text-base sm:text-lg font-medium leading-relaxed text-[#4A2233]/80 tracking-normal
hierarchy.button: font-sans text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold tracking-wide text-white uppercase
hierarchy.section_heading: font-sans text-xs tracking-[0.2em] font-bold uppercase text-[#E8B96A]

sequence: 2. Pink lipstick kiss mark presses in center with slight bounce & tilt
3. Beat later: her name 'Lauofgirly' writes itself in script below
intro_animation.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion to skip overlay instantly

motion.cta_button_idle: Gentle breathing pulse animation (scale [1.0, 1.03, 1.0], opacity pulse, soft halo shadow glow) to draw visitor focus without feeling flashing or cheap
motion.kiss_motif_interaction: Small kiss mark motif appears on button hover/tap and quietly sits as an aesthetic stamp in one corner of the photo gallery

layout_and_grid.container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen px-4 py-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-start text-center relative selection:bg-[#F7CAD9] selection:text-[#4A2233]
layout_and_grid.hero_portrait: relative w-full aspect-[4/5] rounded-[2.5rem] overflow-hidden shadow-xl border-2 border-[#E8B96A]/30 mb-6 group
layout_and_grid.gallery_grid: grid grid-cols-2 gap-3.5 my-8 w-full auto-rows-[140px] sm:auto-rows-[180px]
gallery_asymmetry: Item 6: col-span-2 row-span-1 (Wide wide panorama asset with kiss mark corner overlay)

seo_and_meta.title: Lauofgirly | Univers Beauté & Sensualité Douce
seo_and_meta.meta_description: Découvrez le monde exclusif de Lauofgirly. Contenus beauté, esthétique raffinée et moments privilégiés.
seo_and_meta.og_description: Rejoins-moi pour découvrir mes photos et créations exclusives. Un clic pour tout voir.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure html lang='fr' is configured on document root.
Load Google Fonts ('Great Vibes' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans') in index.html.
Implement skippable Intro overlay with lipstick kiss animation (framer-motion or CSS keyframes) stored in sessionStorage.
Strictly follow color rules: #FFF4F7 background, #F7CAD9 surfaces, #E8B96A gold borders/accents, #4A2233 plum text, and ONLY the two CTA buttons in hot pink #FF4D8D.
Include both primary and secondary CTA buttons labeled 'Viens voir' with target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'.
Create interactive photo gallery lightbox when tapping any image in the irregular grid.
Add discreet kiss mark icon on hover/tap of CTA button and in corner of gallery card.
Ensure responsiveness starting at mobile 375px width up to desktop preview centered container.

Add proper data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='intro-overlay', data-testid='hero-portrait', data-testid='cta-button-primary', data-testid='cta-button-secondary', data-testid='gallery-grid', data-testid='lightbox-modal') on key elements.
